findings.evidence: Header.lean:144 comment; Header.lean:163-165 `if (line.drop "Authors:".length).trimAscii.isEmpty then ... "Please, add at least one author!"`; TauCeti/Topology/JordanCurve.lean:4 `Authors: The Tau Ceti contributors`.
findings.fix: State the actual constraint and the actual reason: the linter requires a non-empty `Authors:` line but cannot check the names; Tau Ceti declines to fill it with a collective placeholder that credits nobody, so the check would flag ~1600 files without adding information.
findings.issue: "a non-empty `Authors:` line naming individuals" overstates the linter. `Mathlib/Tactic/Linter/Header.lean:144` states "We cannot reasonably validate the author names"; the only substantive check is `Header.lean:163` (non-empty after `Authors:`). A collective line such as `Authors: The Tau Ceti contributors` passes, and files already use it, so "there is no such line to write" is false as a technical claim — the linter is off by choice, not necessity.

findings.evidence: grep '^Authors:' TauCeti/ → 426 files, incl. TauCeti/Topology/Sym.lean:4 `Authors: Claude`, TauCeti/GroupTheory/SpecificGroups/CFSG/Sporadic/Suzuki.lean:4 `Authors: Codex`.
findings.fix: Say to copy only the copyright and license lines (`Copyright (c) <year> The Tau Ceti contributors. All rights reserved.` / `Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.`) and not any `Authors:` line the neighbour happens to have.
findings.issue: "Copy the copyright block from a neighbouring file ... and add an `Authors:` line only when there are named human authors" is self-contradictory: 426 files carry an `Authors:` line, many naming AI agents, so copying a neighbour's block propagates exactly the line the clause forbids.

summary: The setting, the non-empty Authors requirement, and the file counts all check out, but the recorded rationale misstates what the linter enforces: it accepts any non-empty Authors string, so keeping it off is a policy choice rather than a technical necessity. The copy-from-a-neighbour instruction also contradicts its own next clause.
